en.t: As she said this, she began to laugh again.

units.source_text: 即使在枕边纸灯笼的昏暗的灯光下，我也没有忘却视察，因为观察是我生存的证据。

en.t: Even in the dim light of the paper lantern by the pillow, I did not forget to observe, because observation was the proof of my existence.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，这段靠近地观察别人的两只眼睛，还是头一回。

en.t: Even so, it was the first time that these two eyes had observed another person from such close range.

units.source_text: 我过去观察世界的远近法崩溃了。

en.t: The perspective through which I had once observed the world collapsed.

units.source_text: 别人无所畏惧地侵犯我的存在，

en.t: Another person fearlessly invaded my existence,

units.source_text: 她的体温连同廉价香水的味儿，恍如浸在水中，

en.t: her body heat together with the smell of cheap perfume seemed to be steeped in water,

units.source_text: 水位一点点地上涨，直到把我淹没了。

en.t: and the water level rose little by little until it submerged me.

units.source_text: 我第一次看到他人的世界是这样地完全融合了。

en.t: For the first time, I saw that another person's world could merge so completely in this way.
